generated_for: Omics Approaches to Predictive Prevention Tools for Disease Surveillance Through WBE

evidence_tier_definitions.established: Routinely measured in operational wastewater surveillance programmes; quantitative association with community disease burden reported in peer-reviewed studies.
evidence_tier_definitions.emerging: Peer-reviewed detection in wastewater demonstrated, but quantitative back-calculation to population prevalence is not yet validated.
evidence_tier_definitions.prospective: Biologically plausible and proposed in the literature; no validated wastewater assay or population-scale calibration. Included to define the schema, not to support inference.

parameter_status_definitions.literature: Value taken from the cited peer-reviewed source and usable as a prior.
parameter_status_definitions.requires_local_calibration: No transferable literature value; must be estimated from local excretion/stability studies before any prevalence estimate is published.

biomarkers.name: Pepper mild mottle virus
biomarkers.stability_notes: Highly abundant and comparatively stable in sewage; the de facto faecal-strength normaliser in NWSS submissions.
caveats: Normalisation does not uniformly improve correlation with clinical data; benefit is site-specific (Maal-Bared 2022).

references.citation: Sanchez Jimenez B et al. Protocol to longitudinally quantify SARS-CoV-2 RNA in wastewater using RT-qPCR and pepper mild mottle virus normalization. STAR Protoc. 2024.

Maal-Bared R et al. Does normalization of SARS-CoV-2 concentrations by Pepper Mild Mottle Virus improve correlations and lead time between wastewater surveillance and clinical data. Sci Total Environ. 2022.

Torii S et al. Comparison of five polyethylene glycol precipitation procedures for the RT-qPCR based recovery of murine hepatitis virus, bacteriophage phi6, and pepper mild mottle virus. Sci Total Environ. 2021.

biomarkers.stability_notes: RNA signal declines with in-sewer residence time and temperature; free viral fraction can sharpen early-warning (Zhao 2023).
caveats: Shedding is heterogeneous between individuals and declines over the infection course, so concentration maps to incidence non-linearly.

biomarkers.name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex (IS6110 / rpoB)
biomarkers.stability_notes: Thick-walled mycobacteria persist in the solids fraction; sludge/solids matrices are preferred over liquid.
caveats: Environmental non-tuberculous mycobacteria cross-react with generic targets; IS6110 copy number varies between strains.

biomarkers.name: Metformin
biomarkers.stability_notes: Comparatively stable in sewer transport relative to many prescription drugs (Lin 2020).

excretion.excretion_fraction_basis: fraction of the ABSORBED dose excreted unchanged in urine; metformin is not metabolised in humans
excretion.uncertainty: Oral bioavailability is dose-dependent (~0.4-0.6); propagate as a distribution, not a point value.

caveats: Estimates population *treated* prevalence, not total diabetes prevalence: undiagnosed and non-pharmacologically managed cases are invisible.
Metformin is also prescribed for polycystic ovary syndrome and prediabetes.

references.citation: Zhou X et al. Wastewater-based estimation of diabetes mellitus prevalence in 237 cities: A cross-China study. Sci Total Environ. 2024.
Lin W et al. Evaluating the stability of prescription drugs in municipal wastewater and sewers based on wastewater-based epidemiology. Sci Total Environ. 2020.

biomarkers.name: Atorvastatin and hydroxy-metabolites

excretion.note: Extensive hepatic metabolism and biliary elimination; urinary recovery is low and highly variable.

caveats: Low and variable urinary excretion makes back-calculation to prevalence unreliable without local calibration.

references.citation: Kasprzyk-Hordern B et al. Wastewater-based epidemiology for comprehensive community health diagnostics in a national surveillance study: Mining biochemical markers in wastewater. J Hazard Mater. 2023.

biomarkers.name: Candida auris (ITS2 / C. auris-specific qPCR)
biomarkers.stability_notes: Recovered from the pelleted solids fraction; solids matrices outperform liquid for this organism.
caveats: Detection frequency tracks sewersheds serving healthcare facilities rather than general community prevalence (Barber 2023).
Reported correlation with clinical case counts is weak (r about 0.27, Nwaubani 2024); treat as a facility-level alert signal, not a prevalence estimator.

references.citation: Nwaubani DA et al. Wastewater surveillance of Candida auris in Baltimore. Int J Hyg Environ Health. 2024.

biomarkers.name: Legionella pneumophila (Lpp 24S rRNA target)
biomarkers.stability_notes: Legionella is environmentally replicating in water systems, unlike shed enteric organisms.
caveats: Legionella proliferates in the environment rather than being shed by cases, so wastewater load is NOT a shedding-based prevalence proxy.
Building water systems and cooling-tower drainage, not human excretion, dominate the signal.

references.citation: Legionella occurrence and molecular detection in wastewater treatment plants (PubMed PMID 28501485).
Legionella molecular detection in wastewater treatment systems (PubMed PMID 39338977).
